mapper.select: SELECT S.SCHEDULE_ID, S.SCHEDULE_NM, S.DIAG_TYPE, S.DATA_MODEL_ID, DM.DM_NM AS DATA_MODEL_NM, S.SCHEDULE_TYPE, S.REPEAT_CYCLE, S.REPEAT_TIME, S.REPEAT_DAY_OF_WEEK, S.REPEAT_DAY_OF_MONTH, S.CRON_EXPR, S.USE_YN, S.LAST_EXEC_DT, S.LAST_EXEC_STATUS, S.LAST_EXEC_LOG_ID, S.CRET_USER_ID, S.CRET_DT, S.UPDT_USER_ID, S.UPDT_DT FROM TB_DIAG_SCHEDULE S LEFT JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL DM ON DM.DM_ID = S.DATA_MODEL_ID WHERE S.SCHEDULE_ID = #{scheduleId}

SELECT SCHEDULE_ID, SCHEDULE_NM, DIAG_TYPE, DATA_MODEL_ID, SCHEDULE_TYPE, REPEAT_CYCLE, REPEAT_TIME, REPEAT_DAY_OF_WEEK, REPEAT_DAY_OF_MONTH, CRON_EXPR, USE_YN, LAST_EXEC_DT, LAST_EXEC_STATUS, LAST_EXEC_LOG_ID FROM TB_DIAG_SCHEDULE WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_DIAG_SCHEDULE ( SCHEDULE_ID, SCHEDULE_NM, DIAG_TYPE, DATA_MODEL_ID, SCHEDULE_TYPE, REPEAT_CYCLE, REPEAT_TIME, REPEAT_DAY_OF_WEEK, REPEAT_DAY_OF_MONTH, CRON_EXPR, USE_YN, CRET_USER_ID, CRET_DT ) VALUES ( #{scheduleId}, #{scheduleNm}, #{diagType}, #{dataModelId}, #{scheduleType}, #{repeatCycle}, #{repeatTime}, #{repeatDayOfWeek}, #{repeatDayOfMonth}, #{cronExpr}, COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), #{cretUserId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_DIAG_SCHEDULE SET SCHEDULE_NM = #{scheduleNm}, DIAG_TYPE = #{diagType}, DATA_MODEL_ID = #{dataModelId}, SCHEDULE_TYPE = #{scheduleType}, REPEAT_CYCLE = #{repeatCycle}, REPEAT_TIME = #{repeatTime}, REPEAT_DAY_OF_WEEK = #{repeatDayOfWeek}, REPEAT_DAY_OF_MONTH = #{repeatDayOfMonth}, CRON_EXPR = #{cronExpr}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, UPDT_USER_ID = #{updtUserId}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SCHEDULE_ID = #{scheduleId}
UPDATE TB_DIAG_SCHEDULE SET USE_YN = #{useYn}, UPDT_USER_ID = #{updtUserId}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SCHEDULE_ID = #{scheduleId}
mapper.select: SELECT LOG_ID, SCHEDULE_ID, SCHEDULE_NM_SNAPSHOT, EXEC_DT, EXEC_END_DT, EXEC_STATUS, TRIGGER_TYPE, DIAG_TYPE, DIAG_JOB_ID, STRUCT_DIAG_ID, ERROR_MSG, EXEC_DURATION_SEC FROM TB_DIAG_SCHEDULE_LOG WHERE LOG_ID = #{logId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_DIAG_SCHEDULE_LOG SET EXEC_END_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, EXEC_STATUS = #{execStatus}, ERROR_MSG = #{errorMsg}, EXEC_DURATION_SEC= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - EXEC_DT))::INTEGER, DIAG_JOB_ID = COALESCE(#{diagJobId}, DIAG_JOB_ID), STRUCT_DIAG_ID = COALESCE(#{structDiagId}, STRUCT_DIAG_ID) WHERE LOG_ID = #{logId}

UPDATE TB_DIAG_SCHEDULE_LOG SET EXEC_STATUS = 'ERROR', ERROR_MSG = '[TIMEOUT] 진단 실행이 비정상 종료됨 (타임아웃 초과)', EXEC_END_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, EXEC_DURATION_SEC= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - EXEC_DT))::INTEGER WHERE EXEC_STATUS = 'RUNNING' AND EXEC_DT < (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{minutes} || ' minutes')::interval)
mapper.select: SELECT LOG_ID, SCHEDULE_ID, SCHEDULE_NM_SNAPSHOT, EXEC_DT, EXEC_END_DT, EXEC_STATUS, TRIGGER_TYPE, DIAG_TYPE, DIAG_JOB_ID, STRUCT_DIAG_ID, ERROR_MSG, EXEC_DURATION_SEC FROM TB_DIAG_SCHEDULE_LOG WHERE EXEC_STATUS = 'RUNNING'
SELECT STATUS FROM TB_DIAG_JOB WHERE DIAG_JOB_ID = #{diagJobId}
SELECT STATUS FROM TB_STRUCT_DIAG_HISTORY WHERE DIAG_ID = #{structDiagId}
